scripts.translation:
[冷豔舞姬]
恭喜。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
Move left,
move right~!
And step...!
Dancing can be
more than a hobby.
For me, it's a way of life~
scripts.translation:
[冷豔舞姬]
向左，向右~！
再邁一步...！
舞蹈不只是愛好，對我來說，更是一種生活方式~

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
The land of Midgard
is in need of talented women
to subtly change the balances
in the battle between good
and evil.
scripts.translation:
[冷豔舞姬]
米德加爾特需要有才華的女性，以巧妙的方式改變正邪之戰的力量對比。

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
Are you ready
to take up this role,
and become a Gypsy?
scripts.translation:
[冷豔舞姬]
你準備好肩負這份使命，成為冷豔舞姬了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[冷豔舞姬]
準備好了，隨時回來吧。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[冷豔舞姬]
你還有可以學習的技能。
請用完剩餘的技能點，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
Congratulations!
As a Gypsy, I know
that your performances
sway the hearts of all
those who will be watching...
scripts.translation:
[冷豔舞姬]
恭喜！
我相信，身為冷豔舞姬，你的表演會打動每一位觀眾的心...

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[冷豔舞姬]
歡迎來到榮耀之廳——英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[冷豔舞姬]
在這裡安心休息吧。
向勇士們致敬！
